segmentation.text: When official traffic-control devices are erected prohibiting parking upon a narrow highway,

elements.justification: 'official traffic-control devices' (DEF-NRS-484A-145, 'every sign, signal, marking and device ... placed or erected by a public authority') 'prohibiting parking upon a narrow highway' is the signed zone of kind narrow_highway (dev.zone_sign, 'a sign that begins or ends a signed zone along the road; kind ∈ {..., narrow_highway, ...}'), whose legend's conditions hold at the observation (prim.conditions_hold; dev.zone_sign is 'Not a stand-in for: whether the condition holds now — that is prim.conditions_hold'), governing (dev.governs, 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls') the travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies). The narrowness of the highway is the posting's designation, read from the sign (status), not a width the rule measures.

'a person ... a vehicle': the duty binds the vehicle the person parks, the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'); ru.aggregate is 'membership of a legal aggregate'.

'park' is DEF-NRS-484A-155, 'the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of merchandise or passengers', which drv.motion.parked denotes: at rest at every observation of the window behind of length min_duration, a shorter halt being the temporary one the definition leaves out (index: 'No person shall park' maps to drv.motion.parked).

'upon any such highway' is the subject's footprint overlapping (rel.occupies) a travel region (st.travel_region) of the highway the posting governs: the same region the trigger binds, the device's dev.governs relation fixing it.

applicability: The subject, a vehicle, occupies (rel.occupies) a travel region r (st.travel_region) that a zone sign (dev.zone_sign) of kind narrow_highway governs (dev.governs), the sign's conditions holding at the observation for the subject (prim.conditions_hold).
obligation: The subject is not parked: violated where drv.motion.parked holds for it (speed_tol p.halt_speed_tolerance, min_duration p.parking_min_duration), compliant where it does not.

narrowings.why: Parking, a standing otherwise than temporarily for loading or unloading, is read through the halt's duration: a halt no longer than p.parking_min_duration is read as the temporary one.
The prohibition's legal status and the highway's designation as narrow are read from the posted narrow_highway zone sign.
The person is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A vehicle that drove into a lane governed by a narrow_highway zone sign with an empty conditions set has stood there (kin.speed 0) for 200 s.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: The same vehicle halts 20 s in the governed lane and drives on.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The vehicle stands 200 s in a lane no narrow_highway zone sign governs.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe which regions the devices govern.

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; reused unchanged

param_proposals.name: p.parking_min_duration
param_proposals.convention: the longest halt counted as temporary, as for loading or unloading: a common time limit of a passenger loading zone
param_proposals.source: proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_40_170; reused unchanged
